contexts.text: They made themselves girdles () = to be affected with shame.
Justice shall be the girdle of His loins, and Truth the girdle of His thighs (). Explained.
The girdle of His thighs () = the love of truth.
The girdle of linen () = truth; and the placing of it on the loins was a representative that the truth was from good. AC 7601:7, Explained.
The girdle of leather about his loins () = the literal sense as to goods, ( = external truth. AC 7643:end.) AE 543:14.
Saturn's ring gives much light. AC 8951. Its appearance to them. AC 8952.
As it were two radiant belts... HH 120.

By the loins being girded () = is signified fitness to receive the influx of good and truth from the Lord, and also to do according to the influx. All girding and investiture = a state prepared to receive and act; for then each and all things are kept in their order. It is otherwise when they are not girded.

The sons of Israel went up girded out of the land of Egypt () = that they were taken out of a state of infestations, and thus prepared to endure temptations... To go up girded = that they were prepared; here, to endure temptations.

When thou wast a boy, thou girdedst thy loins... () = that the faith of the Church at its beginning is the faith of truth from good, and thus the faith of charity towards the neighbour and of love to the Lord... For the loins = the goods of love. Hence to gird the loins = to clothe good with truths... When thou art become old... another shall gird thy loins... = that at the end of the Church... the falsities of evil from the loves of self and the world will succeed. AC 10087:3, Explained. AE 9:4, Explained. AE 195:14.

The girdle of the loins () = the external bond holding together all things of love, and thence of faith... The girdle marred so as to be profitable for nothing = that all the things of love and faith are then dissolved and dispersed.
By a leathern girdle is signified the external bond which connects and keeps in order all the interior things.
Hooks and fillets () = methods of conjunction.
Under Belt, see this reference. AC 9828:3. AC 10014.
By the girdles of the loins were represented celestial goods; and by the girdles of the thighs, and also of the breast, spiritual goods and truths in the ultimates. Illustrated.
By the linen girdle () is meant... the good of the Church which encloses and holds in connection the truths there...
That a girdle = the good which bounds and conjoins. Illustrated.
Leather = what is external... therefore a leathern girdle = that which gathers together, encloses, and holds in connection interior things.
When truths have been dispersed and destroyed, it is said, Instead of a girdle there shall be a rent ()... A rent instead of a girdle = the dissipation of celestial good.
The girdles with which they were girt about the loins () = the goods which they simulate, so that their truths may be believed on that account.
From this it may appear what was signified in the representative Church by the girdles by which the garments were gathered together into one.
The girdle of the ephod () = the external bond which gathers together; (for) a girdle = the general bond by which interior things are held together in connection. AC 9895.
There were two girdles. Explained.
To gird = to know and apperceive truths in light, from good.
A girdle = conjunction... That a girdle = conjunction and a bond that all things may be held in connection, so that they may regard one end. References.
By a girdle is signified a bond holding together truths and goods in their connection. References.
There was afterwards seen a great dim belt round the Sun... Explained.
See Girdle. AR 671.
Round his head was a bright hand...
On a cincture of the neck.
To gird one's self = to draw in and apperceive truths.
Occurs.

The girdle on the loins of the prophet () = the conjunction of the Lord with the Church through the Word... The girdle marred... = that there was not any conjunction whatever of the Church with the Lord; thus no Church. AE 569:20.
The leathern girdle about the loins (of John the Baptist) = the external bond or connection (of the exterior) with the interior things of the Word.
Instead of a robe a girding of sackcloth (). Explained... A rent instead of a girdle = the dissipation of the perceptions of truth, instead of the connection of them.
That they then clothed themselves with natural truths, lest they should appear to be deprived of celestial truths, is signified by their sewing fig leaves together, and making themselves girdles.

Justice shall be the girdle of His loins, and Truth the girdle of His thighs = that the Divine good... shall conjoin those... who are in love to Him, and that the Divine truth... shall conjoin those... who are in love towards their neighbour... By a girdle is signified conjunction with those in Heaven and in the Church.
To gird himself and walk = to learn truths and live according to them... Another shall gird thee... = to acknowledge as truth what another dictates...
The girdle of linen () = all the truth of doctrine from the Word.
Incinctus occurs. DeConj 66.
